propositions: The Blender vendor files (G1) should be ignored (re-downloadable, exceed GitHub limits).
The PCSX2 AppImage (G2) should be kept (pinned dependency, under limits).
The savestates and unpacked dumps (G3) should be ignored (regenerable via re-capture).
The job-b-live working sets (G4) should be ignored (rebuilt by probe tools).
The reference corpus (G6) must be kept (the deliverable).
The F8 screenshots (13M, ground-truth evidence) should be kept.
Excluding files that tools read at fixed paths is acceptable if documented.
args.context:
Candidate file groups in the carmodels repo (Ford Racing 2 recovery), with sizes:
G1 tools/validation-runtime 1.1G: Blender dmg + mounted Blender.app (third-party, re-downloadable). Scripts validate GLBs through Blender.
G2 tools/headless-runtime AppImage 57M: PCSX2 v2.8.2 AppImage, pinned emulator dependency for the container.
G3 research/evidence/continuation/runtime 960M: 40 savestates (.p2s ~11MB each) + unpacked EE/IOP/VU/hw-reg dumps + 13M F8 screenshots. Receipts record sha256 of these files.
G4 research/evidence/job-b-live 704M: pairs/*-eeMemory.bin + members/ extracted dumps (experiment working sets, rebuilt by the probe tools).
G5 viewer 57M: web viewer incl. vendor three.js + 35 recovered .glb files.
G6 reference 65M: the per-car reference corpus (models, textures, sounds) — the deliverable.
G7 recovered 972K: canonical index + per-car manifests.
G8 receipts JSON (~5M total): validation receipts, Jev receipts, tickets, reports.
G9 tools/*.py + batteries: all scripts.
G10 869 .pyc / __pycache__: bytecode regenerable.
Context: user cancelled a 2.6GB push; wants a lean repo. GitHub rejects files >100MB (only the Blender files exceed it). Tools read the unpacked runtime dumps at fixed paths (e.g. verify_selector_word reads RUNTIME eeMemory.bin); excluding them means a fresh clone cannot re-run those tools without re-capturing.
